settings.service.on: Optimization works without the window and starts after a reboot
settings.service.off: Optimization works only while the app is open
settings.close.hint: Closing the app turns optimization off.
settings.lang.title: Language
settings.lang.hint: A custom translation is a <code>.json file in the lang folder next to the app or in %AppData%\DpiShell\lang.
settings.lang.template.hint: A file with every string: the value is the English text, the Russian one is next to it. Once the values are translated and _meta is filled in, the file works as a custom translation.
settings.changes.title: DpiShell changes
settings.changes.hint: Values from before DpiShell come back; later edits are not touched.
